tier: Pay as you go / monthly pool

free_tier.stated: Creating an account is free, but new accounts do not receive automatic trial credits; usage requires purchased credits, a paid plan or an administrator-granted allowance.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a microVM with a writable disk from 64 MiB to 1 TiB, not a stored object

retention.stated: Retained disks remain billable after coverage ends; retained disks persist 30 days after expiry and are not automatically deleted.

egress.terms: Managed internet transfer is $0.10 per GiB billed separately; monthly pools include a shared transfer allowance, and public routes and a user's own proxy do not incur the managed-proxy charge.
egress.free_allowance: 100 GiB included with the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 40 GiB monthly pool
egress.price_per_tb: USD 102.40 per TB at $0.10 per GiB

interface_detail: An SDK and REST API control full Linux microVMs, with SSH password or key auth, interactive shells over WebSocket, public port URLs and MCP access.
tooling: TypeScript SDK, REST API, command-line tool, SSH, MCP and a dashboard; images include Ubuntu, Node.js, Python, Go, Rust, Redis and Postgres.
chaining: $0.03 per active vCPU-hour plus $0.008 per reserved GiB-hour makes a two-vCPU, 4 GiB VM about $0.092 an hour at full CPU, and a monthly $18 pool includes 100 GiB of transfer with a 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 40 GiB fleet.

limits.value: $0.03 per active vCPU-hour, $0.008 per reserved GiB-hour of RAM and $0.05 per retained GiB-month of storage, capped at 125 percent of the monthly pool price
managed internet transfer $0.10 per GiB; the 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 40 GiB monthly pool includes 100 GiB

limits_note: VMs can start at 0.1 vCPU, 128 MiB RAM and 64 MiB writable disk; a pool starts at 256 MiB RAM and 1 GiB storage.
binding_note: No trial credit is granted, so the prepaid wallet and the 125 percent pay-as-you-go ceiling bind first; at full CPU a two-vCPU, 4 GiB VM is about $0.092 an hour.

identity_cost.detail: Account creation needs a valid email address, a secure password and accurate registration information, or a GitHub, GitLab or Google third-party sign-in; creating an account is free, and usage needs purchased credits, a paid plan or an administrator-granted allowance.

reliability_note: Capacity admission can reject a pool when host inventory is unavailable; an empty wallet leaves a storage balance due rather than free compute, and accounts with overdue balances over 60 days may be terminated.
confidence_note: Rates, the absence of trial credits, the account fields and egress price are quoted from the vendor's own pricing page, terms, billing guide and published rate catalog read on 2026-11-25.

notes: At full CPU a two-vCPU, 4 GiB VM is $0.092 an hour by the published rates, matching the operator list. There is no automatic trial credit: the account is free to create but every VM needs wallet funds or a pool. MCP access and the hosted service are the offered path; an open-source self-hosted deployment platform from the same vendor is separate and ranks after this hosted offer.
